observations: A September 24, 2026 Form 8-K records Infleqtion's announcement that it demonstrated 30 entangled logical qubits on its Sqale quantum computer and furnished both the release and Quantum World Congress presentation materials.

The furnished exhibit states the demonstration used 80 physical qubits, entangled all 30 logical qubits in one coherent state, and produced a signal approximately 1000x stronger than underlying noise.
The exhibit states Infleqtion has three customers for logical-qubit circuits on Sqale, including the Wellcome Leap Q4Bio program.

This is a material execution update versus the packet's June 30 reference point of 12 logical qubits, but the SEC filing is disclosure of issuer-supplied technical claims rather than independent experimental replication.

risks.risk: The 30-logical-qubit result is issuer-reported through an SEC furnishing; independent technical replication and customer-level economics remain unverified.
Technical roadmap execution does not itself establish scalable revenue, margins, or economic quantum advantage.

contradictions.contradiction: The prior packet treated independent verification of the targeted 30-logical-qubit 2026 milestone as open; the company has now reported achieving that milestone, but independent verification remains open.
contradictions.disposition: execution milestone advanced; independence question remains

unknowns.unknown: Independent replication or third-party technical validation of the 30-entangled-logical-qubit experiment.
Revenue contribution, pricing, retention and unit economics of the three stated logical-qubit circuit customers.

recommendation: Alpha should reuse this fresh SEC-addressed execution evidence when constructing source-addressed catalyst/scenario evidence, while keeping independent technical validation and customer economics explicitly uncertain.
